Class EndOfRoundPhase

java.lang.Object
model.phaseHandlers.EndOfRoundPhase
All Implemented Interfaces:
GamePhaseHandler, GameCommandVisitor
public class EndOfRoundPhase extends Object implements GamePhaseHandler
Represents the transitional phase executed at the end of each game round, responsible for standard event resolution and phase branching. Upon activation, this handler triggers the routine event resolution logic, broadcasting individual updates to all connected virtual views to allow clients to render intermediate resolution states. Following resolution, it increments the global round counter and evaluates the match termination conditions.

This phase determines the next state of the game by branching into one of two paths:

  • Match Continuation: If terminal conditions are not met, checks for era transitions (notifying observers upon change), and routes the state machine into the next PlacementPhase.
  • Match Termination: If the game is flagged as over, it immediately triggers a transition into a standard EndOfGamePhase.
